fewShots.question: List patients with high readmission risk scores above 0.7
fewShots.query: SELECT dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dp.age_group, fe.encounter_id, fe.encounter_type, fe.discharge_disposition, fe.readmission_risk_score, fe.readmission_risk_category, fe.length_of_stay FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 WHERE fe.readmission_risk_score > 0.7 ORDER BY fe.readmission_risk_score DESC

fewShots.question: Show me the top 10 highest-value denied claims with patient names
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 10 fc.claim_id, dp.first_name, dp.last_name, py.payer_name, fc.billed_amount, fc.primary_denial_reason, fc.recommended_action FROM fact_claim fc JOIN dim_patient dp ON fc.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_payer py ON fc.payer_key = py.payer_key WHERE fc.denial_flag = 1 ORDER BY fc.billed_amount DESC

fewShots.question: Show me claims with high denial risk that are still pending
fewShots.query: SELECT fc.claim_id, dp.first_name, dp.last_name, py.payer_name, fc.billed_amount, fc.denial_risk_score, fc.recommended_action FROM fact_claim fc JOIN dim_patient dp ON fc.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_payer py ON fc.payer_key = py.payer_key WHERE fc.denial_risk_category = 'High' AND fc.claim_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY fc.denial_risk_score DESC

fewShots.question: Show me denied claims with their primary diagnosis
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 fc.claim_id, dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dd_diag.icd_code, dd_diag.icd_description, fc.billed_amount, fc.primary_denial_reason, fe.encounter_type, fe.length_of_stay FROM fact_claim fc JOIN fact_encounter fe ON fc.encounter_key = fe.encounter_key JOIN fact_diagnosis fd ON fe.encounter_key = fd.encounter_key AND fd.diagnosis_type = 'principal' JOIN dim_diagnosis dd_diag ON fd.diagnosis_key = dd_diag.diagnosis_key JOIN dim_patient dp ON fc.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 WHERE fc.denial_flag = 1 ORDER BY fc.billed_amount DESC

fewShots.question: Which providers are driving a specific denial reason?
fewShots.query: SELECT dpr.display_name, dpr.specialty, fc.primary_denial_reason, COUNT(*) as denied_claims, SUM(fc.billed_amount) as denied_dollars FROM fact_claim fc JOIN dim_provider dpr ON fc.provider_key = dpr.provider_key AND dpr.is_current = 1 WHERE fc.denial_flag = 1 GROUP BY dpr.display_name, dpr.specialty, fc.primary_denial_reason ORDER BY denied_claims DESC

fewShots.question: Show me details for patient PAT0000001
fewShots.query: SELECT patient_id, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, age, age_group, gender, city, state, zip_code, insurance_type, insurance_provider, is_current FROM dim_patient WHERE patient_id = 'PAT0000001' AND is_current = 1

fewShots.question: How many patients are in each age group?
fewShots.query: SELECT age_group, COUNT(*) as patient_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 END) as male_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 END) as female_count FROM dim_patient WHERE is_current = 1 GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY patient_count DESC

fewShots.question: Which patients with chronic conditions are non-adherent to their medications?
fewShots.query: SELECT dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dm.medication_name, dm.drug_class, ma.pdc_score, ma.adherence_category, ma.gap_days FROM agg_medication_adherence ma JOIN dim_patient dp ON ma.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_medication dm ON ma.medication_key = dm.medication_key WHERE ma.is_chronic = 1 AND ma.adherence_category = 'Non-Adherent' ORDER BY ma.pdc_score ASC

fewShots.question: Which patients have the highest prescription costs?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, COUNT(*) as total_fills, SUM(fp.total_cost) as total_cost, SUM(fp.patient_copay) as total_copay FROM fact_prescription fp JOIN dim_patient dp ON fp.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 GROUP BY dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age ORDER BY total_cost DESC

fewShots.question: What are the top diagnoses by volume?
fewShots.query: SELECT dd.icd_code, dd.icd_description, dd.icd_category, dd.is_chronic, COUNT(*) as diagnosis_count FROM fact_diagnosis fd JOIN dim_diagnosis dd ON fd.diagnosis_key = dd.diagnosis_key GROUP BY dd.icd_code, dd.icd_description, dd.icd_category, dd.is_chronic ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC

fewShots.question: Show me members living in high social vulnerability zip codes
fewShots.query: SELECT dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dp.city, dp.zip_code, s.risk_tier, s.social_vulnerability_index, s.poverty_rate, s.food_desert_flag, s.transportation_score, s.median_household_income FROM dim_patient dp JOIN dim_sdoh s ON dp.zip_code = s.zip_code WHERE dp.is_current = 1 AND s.risk_tier = 'High' ORDER BY s.social_vulnerability_index DESC

fewShots.question: Show me all denied claims over $50,000 — include the patient, payer, denial reason, and billed amount.
fewShots.query: SELECT fc.claim_id, dp.first_name, dp.last_name, py.payer_name, fc.billed_amount, fc.paid_amount, fc.primary_denial_reason, fc.claim_status FROM fact_claim fc JOIN dim_patient dp ON fc.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_payer py ON fc.payer_key = py.payer_key WHERE fc.denial_flag = 1 AND fc.billed_amount > 50000 ORDER BY fc.billed_amount DESC

fewShots.question: Show me members who are non-adherent to their medications with their drug class and gap days.
fewShots.query: SELECT dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dm.medication_name, dm.drug_class, ma.pdc_score, ma.adherence_category, ma.gap_days, ma.total_fills FROM agg_medication_adherence ma JOIN dim_patient dp ON ma.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_medication dm ON ma.medication_key = dm.medication_key WHERE ma.adherence_category = 'Non-Adherent' ORDER BY ma.pdc_score ASC

fewShots.question: Which patients have had the most encounters in the past 12 months?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dp.insurance_type, COUNT(*) as encounter_count, SUM(fe.total_charges) as total_charges, MAX(fe.readmission_risk_score) as max_risk_score FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_date dd ON fe.encounter_date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.full_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, GETDATE()) GROUP BY dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dp.insurance_type ORDER BY encounter_count DESC

fewShots.question: Show me patients who were readmitted AND are non-adherent to their medications. Include their risk scores and drug class.
fewShots.query: SELECT DISTINCT dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, fe.readmission_risk_score, fe.readmission_risk_category, ma.pdc_score, ma.adherence_category, dm.drug_class, dm.medication_name FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN agg_medication_adherence ma ON dp.patient_key = ma.patient_key JOIN dim_medication dm ON ma.medication_key = dm.medication_key WHERE fe.readmission_flag = 1 AND ma.adherence_category = 'Non-Adherent' ORDER BY fe.readmission_risk_score DESC

fewShots.question: Show me non-adherent patients with their full names and the drug classes they are non-adherent to.
fewShots.query: SELECT dp.patient_id, CONCAT(dp.first_name, ' ', dp.last_name) AS patient_name, dp.age, dm.drug_class, dm.therapeutic_area, ama.pdc_score, ama.gap_days FROM agg_medication_adherence ama JOIN dim_patient dp ON dp.patient_key = ama.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_medication dm ON dm.medication_key = ama.medication_key WHERE ama.adherence_category = 'Non-Adherent' ORDER BY patient_name, dm.drug_class

fewShots.question: Show me medication adherence for Jane Doe age 50 by drug class.
fewShots.query: SELECT CONCAT(dp.first_name, ' ', dp.last_name) AS patient_name, dp.age, dm.drug_class, dm.therapeutic_area, COUNT(*) AS medications_in_class, AVG(ama.pdc_score) AS avg_pdc_score, MIN(ama.pdc_score) AS worst_pdc_score, SUM(ama.gap_days) AS total_gap_days, MAX(ama.adherence_category) AS worst_adherence_category, STRING_AGG(dm.medication_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dm.medication_name) AS medications FROM agg_medication_adherence ama JOIN dim_patient dp ON dp.patient_key = ama.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_medication dm ON dm.medication_key = ama.medication_key WHERE dp.first_name = 'Jane' AND dp.last_name = 'Doe' AND dp.age = 50 GROUP BY dp.first_name, dp.last_name, dp.age, dm.drug_class, dm.therapeutic_area ORDER BY worst_pdc_score ASC

fewShots.question: Please list the 5 most recent encounters for denial reason 'Missing Documentation', only include encounters with a prescription
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 5 fe.encounter_id, CONCAT(dp.first_name, ' ', dp.last_name) AS patient_name, dd.full_date AS encounter_date, fe.encounter_type, dpr.display_name AS provider_name, dpr.specialty, fc.claim_id, fc.primary_denial_reason, fc.billed_amount FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN fact_claim fc ON fe.encounter_key = fc.encounter_key JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_provider dpr ON fe.provider_key = dpr.provider_key AND dpr.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_date dd ON fe.encounter_date_key = dd.date_key WHERE fc.primary_denial_reason = 'Missing Documentation' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_prescription fp WHERE fp.encounter_key = fe.encounter_key) ORDER BY fe.encounter_date_key DESC

fewShots.question: I would like to see full details for encounter ENC00014657, please include provider, diagnosis and prescription information
fewShots.query: SELECT fe.encounter_id, CONCAT(dp.first_name, ' ', dp.last_name) AS patient_name, dp.age, dp.insurance_type, dpr.display_name AS provider_name, dpr.specialty, dpr.department, dd.full_date AS encounter_date, fe.encounter_type, fe.admission_type, fe.discharge_disposition, fe.length_of_stay, fe.total_charges, fe.readmission_risk_category, (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(dx.icd_code, ' - ', dx.icd_description), '; ') FROM fact_diagnosis fd JOIN dim_diagnosis dx ON fd.diagnosis_key = dx.diagnosis_key WHERE fd.encounter_key = fe.encounter_key) AS diagnoses, (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(dm.medication_name, ' (', dm.drug_class, ')'), '; ') FROM fact_prescription fp JOIN dim_medication dm ON fp.medication_key = dm.medication_key WHERE fp.encounter_key = fe.encounter_key) AS prescriptions FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_provider dpr ON fe.provider_key = dpr.provider_key AND dpr.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_date dd ON fe.encounter_date_key = dd.date_key WHERE fe.encounter_id = 'ENC00014657'

fewShots.question: Show me the most recent encounters for patient PAT006030
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 fe.encounter_id, dd.full_date AS encounter_date, fe.encounter_type, dpr.display_name AS provider_name, dpr.specialty, fe.length_of_stay, fe.total_charges FROM fact_encounter fe JOIN dim_patient dp ON fe.patient_key = dp.patient_key AND dp.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_provider dpr ON fe.provider_key = dpr.provider_key AND dpr.is_current = 1 JOIN dim_date dd ON fe.encounter_date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dp.patient_id = 'PAT006030' ORDER BY fe.encounter_date_key DESC
